mx_exact_replay.reason: No retained callable adapter in the clean source line consumes the causal forward's published MXFP4 probability payload/E8M0 scale page at the CompiledGqaBackward boundary. Exploratory fp4_pv_experiments.py probes are not a production substitute.

inputs: forward MXFP4 probability payload or deterministic replay
required_adapter_contract.timing_boundary: replay/publication handoff plus every required clear and attention backward

retained_lowp.d64_exp2_contract: automatic d1/p2 only for measured S/Hq/Hkv shapes: 4096/16/4, 4096/32/8, 4096/64/16, 8192/32/8, and 16384/32/8; all other shapes retain native d2/p0
retained_lowp.d64_probability_tmem_contract: S8192 and S16384 Hq/Hkv=32/8 store FP8 P in the unused D64 TMEM tail; other retained shapes preserve score aliasing
retained_lowp.d64_raster_contract: the measured one-lane direct-TMA TMEM S8192 and S16384 Hq/Hkv=32/8 routes use the head-fast/key-wavefront raster; named comparison controls inherit that raster so they isolate only their advertised direct-TMA, EX2, or detached-P change
retained_lowp.probability_contract: score/LSE reconstruction with retained E4M3 probability path

retained_lowp_alias_p.probability_contract: score/LSE reconstruction with retained E4M3 probability path
retained_lowp_alias_p.reason_d64_only: This control retains score-aliasing FP8 P while inheriting the production raster so detached-P speedup remains measurable.

retained_lowp_detached_p.probability_contract: score/LSE reconstruction with retained E4M3 probability path
retained_lowp_detached_p.reason_d64_only: This control moves FP8 P from the score alias to unused D64 TMEM while inheriting the retained route's physical raster.

retained_lowp_exp2_d1_p2.probability_contract: score/LSE reconstruction with retained E4M3 probability path
retained_lowp_exp2_d1_p2.reason_d64_only: This is a controlled long-sequence D64 screen of the selective packed-ALU EX2 cadence; it is not a D128 policy.

retained_lowp_exp2_d1_p3.probability_contract: score/LSE reconstruction with retained E4M3 probability path
retained_lowp_exp2_d1_p3.reason_d64_only: This is a controlled long-sequence D64 screen of the selective packed-ALU EX2 cadence; it is not a D128 policy.

retained_lowp_native_exp2.probability_contract: score/LSE reconstruction with retained E4M3 probability path
retained_lowp_native_exp2.reason_d64_only: This control forces the pre-dispatch native EX2 implementation.

retained_lowp_no_direct_tma.probability_contract: score/LSE reconstruction with retained E4M3 probability path
retained_lowp_no_direct_tma.reason_d64_only: D128 retained_lowp already uses direct_tma_dkdv=False; this control isolates the D64 direct-TMA dK/dV epilogue only.
